tool_attempts.name: query_business_data
tool_attempts.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT o.id AS order_id,
       o.created_at AS order_created_at,
       o.status AS order_status,
       p.status AS payment_status,
       pr.name AS product_name,
       oi.quantity,
       s.status AS shipment_status,
       s.delivered_at
FROM analytics.orders o
LEFT JOIN analytics.payments p
  ON p.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN analytics.order_items oi
  ON oi.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN analytics.shipments s
  ON s.item_id = oi.id
LEFT JOIN analytics.listings l
  ON l.id = oi.listing_id
LEFT JOIN analytics.products pr
  ON pr.id = l.product_id
WHERE o.id = %(order_id)s
ORDER BY oi.id","parameters_json":"{"order_id":"ord-500d17bb22"}","purpose":"Get current shipment status for the requested order, including item shipment rows and core order/payment context."}

cautions: Seller payout differs from buyer payment.

customers.label: Customer
customers.description: A buyer account that places marketplace orders.

id.description: Customer identifier used by orders.customer_id.

notes: This restricted view exposes buyer identity only, not credentials or other account roles.

sellers.label: Seller
sellers.description: An independent merchant offering products through marketplace listings.

id.description: Seller identifier used by listings and order items.

products.label: Product
products.description: A product identity and category, independent of a seller offer.

id.description: Product identifier referenced by listings.

category.description: Product category used for catalog organization.

listings.label: Listing
listings.description: A seller offer for a product, with its current price and available stock.

id.description: Listing identifier referenced by purchased items.

price.description: Current unit price in integer paise; not necessarily the historical purchase price.

stock.description: Units currently available to purchase; purchases reduce it and completed pre-payout refunds restore returned units.

notes: Use order_items.unit_price for historical purchase values.

orders.label: Order
orders.description: A buyer purchase that can contain items from several sellers.

id.description: Order identifier linking items, payment and tickets.

status.description: Order-level status; successful simulated purchases currently create paid orders.

created_at.description: Purchase time on the demo clock.

notes: Delivery, return, refund and payout statuses belong to separate entities; paid does not mean delivered or settled.

order_items.label: Order item
order_items.description: A purchased listing within an order, retaining the seller, quantity and price at purchase.
order_items.grain: One row per purchased listing in an order, potentially containing multiple units.

id.description: Purchased item identifier used by shipment, allocation and returns.

unit_price.description: Unit price at purchase in integer paise.

notes: Item gross is quantity times unit_price. Aggregate at item or allocation grain before joining one-to-many records.

payments.label: Buyer payment
payments.description: The simulated captured payment from a buyer for an entire order.
payments.grain: One row per order payment in this baseline.

id.description: Payment identifier referenced by allocations and refunds.

amount.description: Original captured order total in integer paise; completed refunds are tracked separately.

status.description: Current simulated payment status; successful purchases create captured payments.

notes: A payment funds multiple item allocations. Do not sum its full amount again for every joined item. Payment is not a seller payout.

shipments.label: Shipment
shipments.description: Fulfillment state and delivery time for the units of a purchased item.
shipments.grain: One row per order item in this baseline.

id.description: Shipment identifier used for dispatch and delivery commands.

quantity.description: Number of units covered by this shipment.

delivered_at.description: Delivery time on the demo clock; null before delivery.

notes: Different items in one order can be delivered separately; splitting an individual item into multiple shipments is not implemented.

allocations.label: Payment allocation
allocations.description: The portion of a captured payment attributable to one purchased item, including settlement accounting.

id.description: Allocation identifier referenced by its payout.

item_id.description: Purchased item whose funds are allocated.

gross.description: Original item gross in integer paise.

fee.description: Current marketplace fee in integer paise, adjusted after completed refunds.

refunded.description: Cumulative completed refunds for this allocation in integer paise; failed refunds do not count.

notes: Remaining seller payable is gross minus fee minus refunded. Monetary accounting is at allocation grain.

payouts.label: Seller payout
payouts.description: Current settlement record for transferring an allocation's net funds to its seller.
payouts.grain: One current payout record per allocation, not one row per attempt.

id.description: Payout identifier referenced by operational events.

allocation_id.description: Allocation being settled; join to order_items for seller identity.

amount.description: Current net seller payable in integer paise; only completed status counts as paid out.

status.description: held, failed or completed in the implemented simulator.

notes: Retries update this record; inspect events for attempt history. Eligibility is computed from delivery, the 24-hour hold and active returns; it is not a separate persisted status.

returns.label: Return request
returns.description: A request to return some or all units of a purchased item.
returns.grain: One row per return request; an item may have multiple requests.

id.description: Return identifier used by the refund record.

quantity.description: Number of units requested for return.

status.description: requested, approved, received, rejected, refunded or manual_review.

notes: Receipt alone is not refund completion. Post-payout returns enter manual_review; automatic recovery is not implemented.

refunds.label: Buyer refund
refunds.description: Current simulated refund record associated with one return and its source payment.
refunds.grain: One refund record per return; a retry updates that record.

id.description: Refund identifier used in events.

status.description: completed or failed in the implemented simulator.

notes: Only completed refunds change allocation.refunded and the fee. Do not sum failed attempts as money returned.

events.label: Business event

id.description: Unique event identifier.

entity_id.description: Identifier of the affected record or demo-clock; resolve its entity type using kind and details.

kind.description: Event/action name, such as payment_captured, payout_failed, purchase or deliver.

occurred_at.description: Business occurrence time on the demo clock.

recorded_at.description: Timestamp when evidence was recorded; seeded history supplies fixed timestamps.

revision.description: Committed demo revision associated with this event.

details.description: Event-specific JSON evidence; its fields vary by kind.

notes: entity_id is a polymorphic reference, not a foreign key to one table. Events can multiply monetary rows when joined; aggregate or filter before joining.

tickets.label: Support ticket
tickets.description: A recorded support issue associated with an order.

id.description: Support ticket identifier.

status.description: Recorded ticket status, such as open.

message.description: Recorded support statement; verify claims against authoritative records and events.

evidence.description: Recorded explanation or evidence references supporting the incident.

seller_balances.description: An analytical view aggregating allocation and payout accounting for each seller.
seller_balances.grain: One row per seller, including sellers with no orders.

seller_id.description: Seller identifier and unique row key.

captured.description: Sum of original allocation gross in integer paise.

refunded.description: Sum of completed allocation refunds in integer paise.

fees.description: Sum of current adjusted marketplace fees in integer paise.

paid_out.description: Sum of payout amounts with completed status, in integer paise.
